ipos.name: M.K.Sons Fine Jewels
ipos.about: M.K. Sons Fine Jewels operates in the gems and jewellery sector, retailing a diverse portfolio of over 19,442 stock-keeping units that includes gold, diamond-studded, coloured stone, platinum, and silver jewellery. The company generates all revenue through direct sales from a retail network of five physical showrooms across Gujarat and Maharashtra. While it does not manufacture products internally, the business relies on an in-house design team to conceptualize new collections, alongside procuring finished articles from external suppliers. Third-party manufacturers and skilled karigars execute production and customization under job-work arrangements. Formed after acquiring the proprietary business of M. K. Sons Jewellers in 2025, the company caters directly to retail customers. To enhance the buying experience, it maintains an exclusive experience lounge tailored for showcasing premium, high-end jewellery to discerning clients.
strengths: Established physical retail footprint with an exclusive experience lounge.
Diverse portfolio of over 19,442 gold, diamond, and platinum SKUs.
Strategic operational focus on high-demand western Indian markets.
Dedicated in-house design team for trend-focused, customizable collections.
Expanding store network driven by strategic inventory deployment.
risks: Revenue generation is heavily concentrated in Gujarat showrooms.
Entirely reliant on third-party manufacturers without long-term contracts.
Profitability is vulnerable to gold and diamond price volatility.
Historical track record of negative operating net cash flows.
High working capital requirements to maintain optimal showroom inventory.

ipos.name: Carver Roboweld
ipos.about: Carver Roboweld is a manufacturer of welding consumables, specifically focusing on welding rods, metal-cored wires, and gouging electrodes, while also supplying various welding spare parts and accessories. The enterprise operates a dedicated manufacturing facility situated in Bamanbore, Rajkot, Gujarat, where it produces its core consumable products. Alongside manufacturing, the business manages three service units located in Pune, Ludhiana, and Hosur. These units support the deployment of its robotic welding systems, welding automation solutions, repair and maintenance services, and overall customer support activities. The entity also provides specialized forging die manufacturing and regeneration services, along with welding robot rental services that utilize specialized operating software. Notably, the business derives its entire revenue from operations exclusively from customers operating within the forging industry. By integrating consumable production with automated robotic deployment, the organization caters directly to the operational and maintenance requirements of its forging sector clientele.
strengths: Exclusive client base within the forging industry.
Three distributed service units ensure efficient robotic support.
Integrated model combining consumables and robot rentals.
Consistent historical revenue growth and profitability.
Dedicated Gujarat facility for consumable production.
risks: Revenues rely entirely on forging industry demand.
Top ten clients generate over 80% of revenue.
High reliance on a few suppliers for raw materials.
Potential cost overruns from delays in robot procurement.
History of delays in statutory dues and filings.

Repay or pre-pay certain borrowings availed by the Company (8.60 (30.40%))

ipos.name: Ajwa Projects
ipos.about: Ajwa Projects engages in industrial services comprising fabrication, piping, erection, pressure equipment installation, prefabricated structures, blasting and painting, maintenance and mechanical services, and civil construction works. The company converts approved engineering plans into functional industrial assets across diverse sectors including oil and gas, refineries, power generation, steel, heavy metals, cement, and transport infrastructure. Its fabrication operations involve machining, welding, and assembling raw materials into structural frameworks, girders, pressure vessels, tanks, ducts, chimneys, and precision components. Erection activities include on-site positioning, alignment, and integration of heavy equipment modules and piping networks. The company also undertakes civil construction works such as site preparation, earthworks, foundations for heavy machinery, and superstructures for industrial facilities. Operating through off-site workshop manufacturing and on-site project execution, Ajwa Projects generates its revenue primarily from contracting services across multiple project sites in India.
strengths: Promoters possess over two decades of extensive industry experience in fabrication and operations.
Integrated service portfolio spanning fabrication, piping, erection, civil works, and maintenance.
Robust and diversified order book valued at ₹42.43 Cr across multiple infrastructure sectors.
Flexible operational execution model utilizing both controlled off-site workshops and on-site locations.
End-to-end execution expertise seamlessly linking component fabrication to on-site installation.

ipos.name: Bombay Coated & Special Steels
ipos.about: Bombay Coated and Special Steels operates a multi-location steel processing centre that caters to the customised requirements of original equipment manufacturers and original design manufacturers. The company primarily procures coated steel coils, such as galvalume, colour-coated, and galvanized, alongside non-coated cold-rolled and hot-rolled steel coils. As an authorised service partner for JSW Steel Coated Products, the company sources most of its raw materials through this arrangement. Using high-precision engineering machinery across its four manufacturing facilities in Maharashtra, Rajasthan, and Andhra Pradesh, it processes these coils into value-added products. These include slit coils, embossed slit coils, blanks, embossed blanks, and sheared blanks, manufactured through specialized slitting, cut-to-length, shearing, and embossing lines. The company generates the majority of its revenue by supplying these processed steel products to the home and commercial appliances sector, while also serving the general engineering, automotive, and electrical equipment industries.
strengths: Authorised service partner of JSWSCPL, ensuring reliable raw material supply.
Strategically located facilities providing efficient logistics and delivery.
High-precision manufacturing setup meeting strict customer specifications.
Long-standing relationships with leading OEM and ODM customers.

Susceptibility to price volatility and disruptions in steel coil supply.
Strong dependence on the cyclical home and commercial appliances sector.

ipos.name: Antala Industries
ipos.about: Antala Industries manufactures, processes, prints, laminates, and supplies industrial and commercial packaging products. The company specializes in the production of BOPP bags, BOPP printing rolls, BOPP lamination rolls, PP woven bags, and PP woven fabric rolls. It operates an integrated manufacturing facility in Rajkot, Gujarat, equipped with extrusion, coating, and lamination, rotogravure printing, roll-to-roll multicolour printing, stitching, and finishing infrastructure to execute all production processes entirely in-house. The company generates revenue by providing customized packaging solutions to clients across sectors including food processing, fertilizers, chemicals, cement, and agricultural seeds. Its offerings provide durability, tensile strength, moisture resistance, and high-quality printability to enable safe bulk storage, transit, and product branding. In addition to customized printed bags with varying closures, sizes, and ply configurations, the company supplies intermediate rolls to other converters and manufactures multi-colour packaging tailored to client specifications.

Operates an integrated in-house manufacturing plant from extrusion to finishing in Rajkot.

ipos.name: Maxwell Engineering Solutions
ipos.about: Maxwell Engineering Solutions is a precision engineering company engaged in the business of manufacturing, trading, and servicing critical components for underwater pelletizing systems. The company manufactures pelletizing die plates, pelletizing blades and knives, blade holders or cutter hubs, tapped driving bushes, and related spare items. It generates revenue primarily through the sale of these manufactured precision components, selective trading of complementary spare items, and provision of services including used die plate refurbishment and repair, intermediary marketing support, and management consulting. Serving diverse applications across polymer compounding, masterbatches, engineering plastics, cable compounds, specialty polymers, and plastics recycling industries, the company operates an owned manufacturing facility in Vadodara equipped with modern CNC and VMC machinery and testing systems. Additionally, it undertakes customized manufacturing to customer specifications and supplies products on a white-label basis, serving customers across India and over twenty international markets.

ipos.name: Vectras Enprocon
ipos.about: Vectras Enprocon is an engineering, procurement, and construction company specializing in environmental engineering solutions, including industrial wastewater treatment, sewage treatment plants, effluent treatment plants, and air pollution control systems. The company designs, manufactures, installs, and commissions end-to-end water and wastewater management infrastructure for diverse industrial and municipal clients across India. It generates revenue primarily through turnkey execution of environmental infrastructure projects, comprehensive operations and maintenance contracts, and direct supply of specialized filtration and pollution-control equipment. With dedicated in-house engineering and fabrication capabilities, the firm delivers customized turnkey solutions catering to chemical, pharmaceutical, textile, power, and general manufacturing industries requiring stringent regulatory compliance and sustainable industrial waste management. Its integrated project lifecycle framework covers conceptual engineering design, civil construction, electro-mechanical assembly, commissioning, and regulatory documentation, ensuring operational efficiency and consistent adherence to mandated environmental discharge norms.

ipos.name: HGS (India)
ipos.about: HGS India manufactures geophones, seismic cables, and geophysical connectors for the energy and geoscience sector. The company’s products are used in seismic data acquisition to detect, record, and transmit ground vibration signals for subsurface geological analysis. Revenue is generated from selling geophone strings and harnesses, seismic cables, and geophysical instruments and accessories to global and domestic clients across diverse end-user industries. These industries include oil and gas exploration, vibration monitoring, earthquake seismology, geophysical seabed surveys, mine exploration, and defense research. The company operates a primary manufacturing facility in Manesar, Gurugram, equipped with precision geophone element assembly, cable extrusion, injection moulding, and automated testing capabilities. HGS India utilizes a dual-hub operating model, combining production in India with international customer engagement and marketing through its wholly owned subsidiary located in the Netherlands to serve multinational customers across global markets.

ipos.name: Johnsoncab Electricals
ipos.about: Johnsoncab Electricals manufactures low-voltage wires and cables up to 1.1 kV for power infrastructure, renewable energy, railways, and industrial applications. The company generates revenue by producing and supplying control cables, power cables, industrial single- and multicore control cables, building wires, and special-purpose cables such as solar, submersible flat, and welding cables under the JOHNSON CABLES brand name. With two manufacturing facilities located in Mehsana, Gujarat, possessing an installed capacity of 79,950 kilometers, the company is equipped for wire drawing, annealing, bunching, insulation, extrusion, testing, and packaging. It serves government entities and private-sector clients through direct customer engagements, vendor approvals, and participation in competitive tenders. In addition, the company holds an Indian patent for three-core double-insulated flat cables for submersible pumps, enhancing its product differentiation in specialized electrical application segments across key domestic infrastructure markets.

ipos.name: Acko
ipos.about: Acko is a Bengaluru-based digital-first insurance company founded in 2016 by Varun Dua. It operates as a direct-to-consumer insurer offering motor, health, travel, and other insurance products through a fully online platform, bypassing traditional agents. The company has positioned itself as a technology-led insurtech player with a strong focus on simplifying policy purchase and claims experience. Backed by investors such as General Atlantic, Accel, and CPP Investments, Acko has raised over $580 million to date and has built scale through embedded distribution partnerships and digital channels.

ipos.name: OYO
ipos.about: Oravel Stays Limited operates a global asset-light hospitality platform connecting property owners with short-stay guests via branding, tech tools, and operational support. It operates across three core verticals: Hotels (OYO, Sunday, Townhouse, Motel 6, Studio 6), Homes (Belvilla, DanCenter, Checkmyguest), and Listings (European subscription services). Additional offerings include wedding venues, co-working spaces, tours, food and beverage, and insurance facilitation. Revenue stems from partner revenue-sharing, home booking commissions, listing subscriptions, and G6 franchisee royalties.As Oyo’s parent prepares for its third IPO attempt under the “PRISM” brand, its evolution from a budget hotel chain into a global distribution platform has driven cash-positive operations. However, a lingering ₹3,000 crore debt load and shrinking direct demand pose ongoing challenges to its growth ambitions. Readmore

ipos.name: Parle Products
ipos.about: Parle Products is one of India’s largest and oldest fast-moving consumer goods (FMCG) companies, founded in 1929 by the Chauhan family in Mumbai. It is best known for its flagship brand Parle-G, widely regarded as the world’s top-selling biscuit. Over decades, the company has built a diversified portfolio including brands such as Monaco, KrackJack, Hide & Seek, Melody, and Mango Bite. With a strong rural and urban distribution network and presence across multiple price segments, Parle remains a dominant player in India’s biscuit and confectionery market.

ipos.name: MakeMyTrip
ipos.about: MakeMyTrip Limited is India’s leading online travel platform, offering services across flights, hotels, holiday packages, rail, bus, and cab bookings through its brands—MakeMyTrip, Goibibo, and redBus. The company is listed on Nasdaq and operates primarily through its Indian subsidiaries, catering to both retail and corporate travel segments. Over the years, it has built a dominant position in India’s online travel market, supported by a wide inventory, strong brand recall, and increasing adoption of digital travel services.

ipos.name: BOAT
ipos.about: Imagine Marketing Limited was incorporated in November 2013 and operates primarily under the brand“boAt”, launched in 2015. The company was founded and is promoted by Sameer Ashok Mehta, Aman Gupta, and South Lake Investment Ltd. It is a digital-first consumer electronics company focused on lifestyle-oriented, mass-premium products at accessible price points.The company designs, markets, and sells a wide range of consumer devices, including personal and large audio products, wearables such as smartwatches and smart rings, and charging solutions like cables, chargers, and power banks. Operations are asset-light, with manufacturing largely outsourced to strategic partners, while the company focuses on product design, branding, marketing, and distribution.

ipos.name: Zepto
ipos.about: Zepto Limited operates a quick commerce platform that enables users to purchase a wide range of products from third-party merchant partners through the “Zepto” mobile application. Orders placed on the platform are processed through strategically located dark stores operated by the company and delivered to users through last-mile delivery partners. In addition to groceries and household products, merchant partners offer freshly prepared food items through Zepto Café, which uses the same dark store and delivery infrastructure. The company also provides advertising and promotional solutions to brand partners, including sponsored placements, in-app advertising, analytics and campaign performance tools, creating an additional monetisation channel. Further, it offers supply chain services by sourcing products from brands and selling them to wholesalers and retailers on a non-exclusive basis. The company’s business is supported by its in-house technology systems that help manage operations, fulfilment, delivery and user engagement.
strengths: Fastest-growing quick commerce platform in India by order volume among scaled players between Fiscal 2024 and Fiscal 2026.

ipos.name: PhonePe
ipos.about: Incorporated in 2015, PhonePe is a leading digital payments and financial services company owned by Walmart. It enables users to perform various financial transactions, including sending and receiving money, recharging mobile phones and DTH services, making utility payments, and conducting in-store transactions. It was India’s first Unified Payments Interface (UPI)-based payments app launched by a non-bank fintech company.

ipos.name: Cult.fit
ipos.about: Cult.Fit Limited is a fitness and wellness company that operates an integrated platform offering fitness services and fitness products through both online and offline channels. The company generates revenue primarily from fitness memberships, partner- and franchise-operated fitness centres, and the sale of fitness products through its digital platform and retail network. Its fitness services include company-owned centres, franchise and marketplace gyms, along with technology-enabled offerings delivered through the Cult.fit app. The company also sells active lifestyle and fitness-related products across multiple categories. Cult.Fit follows an asset-light expansion strategy by franchising fitness centres through its “gym-in-a-box” model, which supports partners with centre design, equipment, and operational processes. Its technology platform integrates fitness services and products, enabling cross-selling, customer engagement, class management, and operational efficiency across its network.

ipos.name: KUKU (Mebigo Labs)
ipos.about: Kuku, operated by parent company Mebigo Labs, is an Indian audio content platform (earlier branded as Kuku FM) focused on audiobooks, stories, and knowledge content in multiple Indian languages. Positioned as a vernacular audio OTT “soonicorn”, it targets the fast‑growing regional‑language user base across Tier‑2 and Tier‑3 cities, building a large subscription‑driven and freemium audience. The company has raised venture funding over the years, and by mid‑2025, its private‑market valuation was reported to be around 500 million dollars, reflecting strong traction and revenue growth, though this is distinct from any eventual IPO pricing.

ipos.name: Tata Sons
ipos.about: Tata Sons Private Limited is the principal investment holding company and promoter of the Tata Group, India’s largest conglomerate, founded over 155 years ago. It sits at the top of a distinctive governance structure combining philanthropic ownership with strategic control across sectors like IT, automotive, materials, aerospace, retail, and hospitality.

ipos.name: Upstox
ipos.about: Upstox is one of India’s leading online trading platforms, backed by prominent investors including Tiger Global Management, Stride Ventures, and the late Ratan Tata. The company achieved unicorn status in 2021 following a funding round that valued it at $3.5 billion. Upstox has raised approximately $220 million across 6 funding rounds to date.

ipos.name: EAAA India Alternatives
ipos.about: EAAA India Alternatives is a prominent alternative asset management platform operating across multiple jurisdictions and regulated by various authorities, including SEBI. The enterprise primarily functions as an investment manager for alternative investment funds and portfolio management services. Its core business activities are divided into two primary operating segments: Private Credit and Real Assets. The Private Credit vertical encompasses performing credit, investment-grade credit, special situations, and real estate credit. The Real Assets segment focuses on infrastructure yield and commercial real estate yield investments. The entity generates its revenue primarily through management and advisory fees charged on the capital committed or invested across its active funds, co-investment vehicles, and infrastructure investment trusts. Additionally, it earns general partner income from its own investments in the managed funds and variable additional returns based on the performance of the underlying investments upon exceeding specified hurdle rates.

ipos.name: Sahajanand Medical Technologies
ipos.about: Sahajanand Medical Technologies develops, manufactures, and markets cardiovascular devices globally. The core business is divided into two primary segments: vascular intervention products, such as coronary stents and balloon catheters, and structural heart devices, including transcatheter aortic valves and occluders. The company generates the majority of its revenue from the sale of vascular intervention devices, with the Supraflex Cruz, a biodegradable polymer-based drug-eluting stent, acting as a major contributor to its sales. Products are distributed across India, Europe, and the rest of the world through a combination of direct, hybrid, and distributor-led models, supported by an extensive network of domestic and international distributors. Operations are backed by manufacturing facilities located in Surat, Hyderabad, and Thailand. Additionally, the business relies heavily on dedicated research and development capabilities to continually enhance existing products and introduce new cardiovascular treatments.
strengths: Strong portfolio of vascular and structural heart medical devices
Extensive domestic and international distribution network
Dedicated in-house research and development capabilities
Multiple manufacturing facilities across India and Thailand
Diversified revenue streams from sales in over 65 countries
risks: High dependency on revenues from the Supraflex Cruz stent
Stringent domestic and global regulatory compliance requirements
Vulnerability to foreign currency exchange rate fluctuations
Reliance on limited third-party suppliers for key raw materials
Exposure to pricing controls and healthcare reimbursement caps

ipos.name: Ravita Engineering Services
ipos.about: Ravita Engineering Services provides engineering solutions for heating, ventilation, and air conditioning (HVAC) systems, temperature control systems, and other allied electro-mechanical equipment. The company operates across three primary business segments: offshore projects, onshore projects, and the data center industry. Its core business activities are divided into Engineering, Procurement, Installation, and Commissioning (EPIC) projects, as well as standalone Operations and Maintenance (O&M) service contracts. In certain instances, the company executes hybrid projects that combine initial EPIC work with subsequent long-term O&M services. The company procures critical hardware components and server infrastructure from third-party original equipment manufacturers to develop and deploy its solutions. Operations are primarily concentrated in western India, with significant project execution occurring in Maharashtra, Gujarat, and the territorial waters of India. Revenue is generated through competitive bidding and tender processes for both public sector undertakings and private corporate clients.
strengths: Diverse HVAC portfolio across offshore, onshore, and data centers.
Strategic geographic presence in western India and offshore regions.
Robust order book and consistent history of profitability.
Strong client relationships driving repeat EPIC contracts.
Specialized expertise in hybrid engineering and O&M projects.
risks: High revenue concentration from top clients poses financial risks.
The geographic concentration in Western India exposes operations to local disruptions.
Dependence on competitive bidding creates revenue uncertainty.
Reliance on contract labor and OEMs risks cost overruns and delays.
Promoter-linked entity strike-off poses regulatory and reputational risks.

ipos.name: TNA Solutions
ipos.about: TNA Solutions manufactures and supplies home textile products to domestic and international markets. The company operates primarily on a business-to-business model, manufacturing customized home furnishings according to client specifications for domestic and overseas brands. Its product portfolio includes sheeting products such as flat sheets, fitted sheets, and duvet sets, as well as pillow pairs, towels, and top-of-bed items like comforters, mattress protectors, and quilts. The company also operates a direct-to-consumer segment under its brand, Ambra Linens. TNA Solutions generates revenue from the sale of these home textile goods across India and export markets including the United States, United Arab Emirates, South Africa, and the United Kingdom. Operations are conducted through its manufacturing facility situated in Indore, Madhya Pradesh, which undertakes cutting, stitching, embroidery, finishing, quality inspection, and packaging, while outsourcing fabric dyeing, printing, and other wet processing to external job workers.
strengths: Diverse home textile product portfolio serving both B2B and B2C segments.
Established international presence with exports to over ten countries.
Expanding manufacturing capacity to effectively meet rising customer demand.
Successful launch of proprietary direct-to-consumer brand, Ambra Linens.
Consistent revenue growth driven by strong relationships with key clients.
risks: Significant revenue concentration in the sheeting product segment.
Heavy reliance on a limited number of B2B customers for the majority of sales.
High working capital requirements have led to negative operating cash flows.
Business operations depend heavily on a single manufacturing facility in Indore.
Reliance on third-party job workers for essential fabric processing activities.
